---
title: "A Random Walk Down Martin Place"
date: "2006-07-28"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

Vanguard Australia is presenting a seminar by Dr Burton G. Malkiel, author of [A Random Walk Down Wall Street](http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/0393062457/ref=ase_institutional-20/002-5247213-4341622?s=books&v=glance&n=283155&tagActionCode=institutional-20 "A Random Walk Down Wall Street"), and Chemical Bank Chairman’s Professor of Economics at Princeton University, 17 August at the Westin Hotel, Martin Place, Sydney.  The topic for the seminar, not surprisingly given the sponsor, is ‘Why It Pays to Invest in Index Funds.’

You can register [here](http://www.vanguard.com.au/seminar.html "here").
